subject: New vendor onboarding: Cobalt Medical — corporate details & PO routing
messages:

Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@cobaltmedical.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor setup: Cobalt Medical — corporate details and PO routing

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Per our conversation, we're attaching the items needed to establish Cobalt Medical in your vendor master so we can begin receiving POs and submit invoices. Please find the attached: W-9 (completed), bank ACH details, and our Articles of Incorporation.

Quick answers to the onboarding fields you asked about on the call:
- Legal entity name: Cobalt Medical, Inc.
- DBA: Cobalt Diagnostics (used on invoices only)
- Federal Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
- Remittance address: 4107 Harbor Lane, Suite 120, Santa Clara, CA 95050
- Preferred invoice recipient: ap@cobaltmedical.com
- Payment terms: Net 45 (we can accept Net 30 upon request)

I've attached the files here (see attachments list). If you need a notarized copy of the articles or additional documentation for AML/KYC, I can get that over by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: W-9_CobaltMedical.pdf (pdf), Bank_Details_ACH.xlsx (xlsx), Articles_of_Incorporation.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — let me know if anything else is required to create the vendor record.

Best,
Sofia
Vendor Operations
Cobalt Medical

(415) 555-0198
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Mendez <sofia.m@cobaltmedical.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T12:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Cobalt Medical — corporate details and PO routing

Hi Sofia — thanks for the packet and the quick turnaround. Confirming receipt and a couple of clarifying items before AP/Onboarding finalize the vendor master record: 

1) Legal name verification: is the Articles of Incorporation you attached the most recent (shows Cobalt Medical, Inc.)? If you have a state filing or certified copy, please include.
2) Tax residency: Are you US tax residents for the entity referenced by that EIN? We need confirmation for tax withholding rules.
3) Invoice cadence: do you submit consolidated monthly invoices or invoice per PO? (We map payables differently depending on that.)
4) Remit email: ap@cobaltmedical.com works — does your accounting team accept invoices at invoices@cobaltmedical.com as well?

Kimberly — can you review the attached W-9 and bank worksheet and confirm whether we need a notarized article or additional verification to proceed? Grace — once Kimberly OKs, can you start the vendor code creation and routing policy (PO-only vs. invoice-accept) and advise on required fields in our Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.docx?

For Sofia: I'll loop you back once AP confirms a vendor number and expected first PO date. We typically require a signed vendor agreement for new suppliers dealing with controlled data — do you have a standard Master Services Agreement? If not, we can send our standard vendor addendum via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Cobalt Medical — corporate details and PO routing

Thanks Markus — reviewing now. A few notes from AP side: 

- W-9: EIN format looks valid; I'll run it against our tax verifier and confirm.
- Bank_Details_ACH.xlsx: Good to have, but we require an ACH test (micro-deposit) before enabling auto-pay. Please ask the vendor if they prefer ACH or wire as primary onboarding step.
- Articles_of_Incorporation: we prefer a certified copy for record; Sofia indicated she can provide notarized docs by EOD tomorrow — please request that.
- Tax residency: If the entity is US-resident (per EIN), standard backup withholding rules apply only if missing TIN; otherwise fine.

Action items for vendor record creation (internal):
1) Create provisional vendor code: PROV-CMB-478 (Grace, can you use this prefix until final code assigned?)
2) Set payment method: ACH pending micro-deposit; set to ManualPay if vendor does not confirm within 5 business days.
3) Flag record for agreement signature: vendor agreement required for data handling (Markus to confirm if vendor will sign Redwood MSA or provide their standard).

Grace — I'm attaching our Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.docx (template) to the thread; please fill vendor code and route to Procurement Ops once we have the certified articles.

Kimberly
AP Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Mendez <sofia.m@cobaltmedical.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@cobaltmedical.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Cobalt Medical — corporate details and PO routing

Hi Markus / Kimberly / Grace — thanks for the checklist and the provisional code. Quick updates: 

- Certified Articles_of_Incorporation (state-certified) attached.
- We confirm US tax residency for the EIN provided.
- Invoicing: we prefer invoice-per-PO, but can do consolidated monthly invoicing if you require. Default: invoice-per-PO.
- Preferred invoice address: ap@cobaltmedical.com (we also monitor invoices@cobaltmedical.com; both acceptable).
- Payment method: ACH preferred. We acknowledge AP will perform micro-deposit.
- Contract: we've completed and returned your MSA via DocuSign — envelope link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456789. Signed copy attached (Signed_Vendor_Agreement_docusign.pdf).

Attachments included: Articles_of_Incorporation_certified.pdf, Signed_Vendor_Agreement_docusign.pdf

Please confirm when the vendor code is promoted from provisional to active and when we can expect the first PO to appear in our portal. Happy to provide additional KYC items if necessary.

Best,
Sofia
Vendor Operations
Cobalt Medical
